metadata.title: Gel Filtration (Size-Exclusion Chromatography) on AKTA start
metadata.purpose: Separate proteins by molecular weight on a cross-linked porous gel (Sephacryl S-100) and estimate the MW of an unknown protein from a Kav-vs-log(MW) standard curve.
metadata.scope: Isocratic size-exclusion chromatography on an AKTA start with a Sephacryl S-100 column, single buffer (PBS, buffer A). Teaching setup; eluted proteins are not collected. Preparative fractionation and other resins are out of scope.
metadata.estimatedTime: One session for the run; column cleaning/regeneration/storage in a later session.
beforeYouBegin: Watch the instrument video and walk through the procedure before starting.
Filter buffer A (0.45 um) and the sample (0.45 um) before use.
Always know the state of each valve and the tubing contents during a programmed run; avoid air bubbles entering the fractionation tubing.

materials.name: Buffer A (50 mM PBS)
materials.specification: 0.14 M NaCl, 36 mM Na2HPO4, 14 mM NaH2PO4, pH 7.2; 0.45 um filtered
materials.rawText: Buffer A: 50 mM PBS (0.14 M NaCl, 36 mM Na2HPO4, 14 mM NaH2PO4), pH 7.2

equipment.name: Chromatography system + pump + computer
equipment.settings: Manual run via system control; flow rates set per step

steps.action: Prepare buffer A; add 400 mL to bottle A; immerse buffer A and buffer B inlet tubing in bottle A.
steps.criticalNotes: Only buffer A is used in this experiment.

steps.action: Switch on AKTA start, install pump tubing, connect the computer.
Manual run: wash buffer A tubing, buffer B tubing, and fractionation tubing; extrude air bubbles.

parameters.rawText: wash buffer A tubing (20 mL); buffer B tubing (20 mL)

steps.action: Prepare the sample (standards + unknown) and filter.
steps.criticalNotes: Sample mix contains blue dextran + 3 standards + unknown.

steps.action: Wash inlet tubing and sample valve; apply the sample.
steps.criticalNotes: Switch the sample valve to buffer quickly after loading to prevent air entering the column.

steps.action: Elute with buffer A; send outlet to waste; continue after the last peak.

parameters.rawText: stop the program after additional 15 min-elution

steps.criticalNotes: Eluted proteins are not collected in this run.

steps.action: Export CSV; plot the elution curve; find V0 and Ve per protein; compute Kav; plot log(MW) vs Kav; estimate the unknown MW.
steps.expectedResult: Standard curve + estimated MW of the unknown.
steps.criticalNotes: Upload via NOWLab; calculation done in Assignment 1.

parameters.rawText: 0.5 M NaCl, 1 CV; 0.1 M HOAc, 1 CV (or 0.2 M NaOH)
water, 1 CV; 20% alcohol, 1 CV for storing

controls.name: Calibration standards
controls.description: BSA (67 kDa), Ovalbumin (45 kDa), Ribonuclease A (13.7 kDa) build the Kav-vs-log(MW) standard curve.

controls.name: Unknown
controls.description: Sample whose MW is estimated from the standard curve.

expectedOutputs: An elution curve (CSV) with resolved peaks.
V0 and elution volume (Ve) per protein; Kav per protein.
A log(MW)-vs-Kav standard curve and an estimated MW for the unknown protein.

troubleshooting.solution: Pause the program or switch the wash valve to waste; switch the sample valve to buffer quickly after loading

troubleshooting.cause: Overloaded sample volume; flow too high
troubleshooting.solution: Reduce sample volume; keep flow at the specified rate

safety: 0.1 M acetic acid and 0.2 M NaOH are corrosive - handle with care.
Standard laboratory PPE; follow the ÄKTA start instrument SOP.
limitations: Teaching run; eluted proteins are not collected. MW estimation assumes globular standards and a valid Kav calibration. Resin lot/column dimensions not specified.
